# Read relationally, comparison ranks consuming formation below its absence

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`relational-reading-comparison` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](relational-reading-comparison.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Read relationally, the course from which an overdrawing formation is absent renews every condition and extends the course with it, an instance of a law of comparison for every family of courses, so comparison principle C ranks it strictly higher; read event by event, C does not decide.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For every family of courses, a course that renews every condition extends another under the relational (whole-run) reading exactly when it is active at every event the other includes and at some event the other withholds; where every formation is active at every step of it, exactly when the other withholds some event. (`Becoming.Ranking.renewed_extends_iff`, `Becoming.Ranking.renewed_active_extends_iff`)
2. Read relationally, so that the active events of formations not consuming conditions of the relations they participate in are the generative grounds, living significance includes exactly those events and is silent on a consumer's events. (`RenewalComparison.g0_relational`, `Becoming.ActiveReading.g0_wholeRun_iff`, `GenerativeComparison.G0`)
3. For every law of the relational-renewal family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal from some step on, the same unfolding without that formation renews every condition and is a generative extension of the unfolding with it, an instance of that law; this holds for a dependent (malignant) and an independent (winning) focal formation alike. (`Becoming.SupportGated.overdraw_extension`, `Becoming.Ranking.whole_run_extends`, `RenewalComparison.overdraw_relational_extension`, `GenerativeComparison.GenerativeExtension`)
4. So the comparison principle C ranks the unfolding without the overdrawing formation strictly higher, and no asymmetric comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw. (`RenewalComparison.overdraw_comparison_ranks`, `Becoming.Ranking.whole_run_ranks`, `RenewalComparison.malignant_comparison`, `Becoming.ActiveReading.malignant_readings`, `GenerativeComparison.ComparisonPrinciple`)
5. Read event by event, the two unfoldings are incomparable by extension, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw. (`RenewalComparison.overdraw_broad_incomparable`, `Becoming.ActiveReading.overdraw_unranked`, `RenewalComparison.broad_comparison_admits_overdraw`, `Becoming.ActiveReading.overdraw_admits_occurrence`)
6. Sharing is a generative extension of winning by consumption under both readings, an instance of the same law and, under the event-by-event reading, of the law of extension for a reading exact on the extending course. (`Becoming.SupportGated.contest_extensions`, `Becoming.ActiveReading.contest_readings`, `RenewalComparison.contest_comparison`, `Becoming.Ranking.extendsUnder_iff_of_exact`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- C (ComparisonPrinciple) is a hypothesis of the ranking theorems, so the comparisons use C, not G0; G0 appears only in the interface theorem g0_relational. Both are imported unchanged from GenerativeComparison.
- Relational reading: a claim is a formation event (formation, step); in a continuation it is a ground when the formation is active then and is not ConsumingIn that continuation. The classification is over the whole continuation.
- The comparison course without the focal formation keeps the law's start, renewal and support level, with no focal activity and no drawing; the support of the sustaining formation holds at the start (needG ≤ start), and needF ≤ needG, 0 < needG and overdraw from some step T0 are as in relational-renewal-classification.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The rankings are the law's instances in one law family and its course without the focal formation.
- Classification is per whole continuation, so a consuming formation's events before its overdraw are not grounds; this record settles no stepwise reading.
- Ranks no mixed cases and decides no fluctuating ones.
- Establishes neither feasibility nor obligation, nor real correspondence.
- As in renewing-consuming-formation, a law that omits rest's restorative role makes C rank rest below continued renewing formation under either reading; rest is not consumption, but this comparison does not represent its value.
- **Counterexample:** broad_comparison_admits_overdraw: under the event-by-event reading, a strict comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw. C alone, without the relational reading of generation, does not rank malignant growth below its absence. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RenewalComparison.lean)
- **Counterexample:** tradeoff_has_opposite_strict_appraisals: when each continuation realizes grounds the other lacks, C does not decide; mixed occurrences that renew some conditions and consume others are not ranked here. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/GenerativeComparison.lean)

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading G0's 'generation' relationally follows Ren's G0, whose object is 生生 ('整体中的生及其继续生成'), and Ren's follow-up that generation and degeneration do not overlap; that reading and C's defense as an articulation of 'a whole direction of ever more 生' are philosophical, not established by the audit. The comparison course is the same unfolding without the focal formation, not a feasible alternative; feasibility and selection belong to P/N and the situation.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [relational-renewal-classification](relational-renewal-classification.md). Imports RelationalRenewal and calls overdraw_consuming, within_renewal_renewing, within_renewal_sustains, independent_overdraw_persists and renewing_not_consuming directly.
  - Output: overdraw_consuming: the focal formation is ConsumingIn, and from some step T the sustaining formation is never active.
  - Input: overdraw_relational_extension excludes the focal events from the grounds and takes the sustaining event at T as the extension's new ground.
  - Preserved conditions: Same Law, 0 < needG, needF ≤ needG, overdraw from T0; additionally needG ≤ start for the course without the focal formation. [RenewalComparison.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RenewalComparison.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [practical-judgment-g0-j](practical-judgment-g0-j.md). Interpretive: C is the explicit comparison premise of the G0/J route; this result shows what C decides once G0's generation is read relationally. No Lean input from that record.
- related, not a proved adapter: [renewing-consuming-formation](renewing-consuming-formation.md). Its event_reading_recognizes_both and comparison_does_not_apply give the broad event reading under G0 and C for a wear law: G0 includes both continuations and C does not apply between them, agreeing with overdraw_broad_incomparable here. This record adds that the relational reading lets C rank the overdraw below its absence. No import either way.
- related, not a proved adapter: [relational-generative-comparison](relational-generative-comparison.md). Same pattern: a structural description fed into C decides a case that a coarser description cannot. Different structure (joint bundles there, consumption here); no formal composition.
- related, not a proved adapter: [positive-ground-open-futures](positive-ground-open-futures.md). Interpretive: uses the same G0 predicate; here its inventory is read relationally.
- related, not a proved adapter: [becoming-stepwise-reading](becoming-stepwise-reading.md). That result gives the stepwise and relation-level readings; ranking-under-readings proves what becomes of this record's rankings under the stepwise reading.
- related, not a proved adapter: [ranking-under-readings](ranking-under-readings.md). That result restates this record's whole-run ranking on the core and proves that under the stepwise reading the ranking of absence is lost and that of sharing is kept.
